name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois, a native of Montreal, brings a wealth of security experience to Herberth Motorsport. His journey began after a career in the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, where he specialized in risk assessment and crisis management. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Jean-Pierre saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his passion, transitioning into the high-stakes world of racing security. 

At Herberth Motorsport, Jean-Pierre takes a proactive approach to security, focusing on preventative measures and comprehensive planning. He emphasizes clear communication, thorough training, and the implementation of robust protocols to ensure the safety of personnel, equipment, and intellectual property. His calm demeanor and sharp analytical skills make him a vital asset during high-pressure situations. What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his ability to anticipate potential threats and develop innovative solutions to mitigate risks, ensuring Herberth Motorsport remains protected on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a stocky man with a serious demeanor and watchful eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Insists on conducting a full security sweep of the paddock before every race, regardless of prior checks.
Has a habit of reciting security protocols aloud to himself when under stress.
